description: Generates an AI workout via Content API. Use when the user wants to create a personalized workout on-the-fly. Not for picking from existing workouts (use recommend_workouts). Returns workout structure; set save_to_library to also save it to the team library.

duration_max.description: Longest workout length in minutes, 10 to 90.

duration_min.description: Shortest workout length in minutes, 10 to 90.

end_user_fitness_levels.description: Member's fitness level as a one-item list, e.g. ["intermediate"]. Values: beginner, intermediate, advanced.

end_user_goal_ids.description: Member's goal IDs from list_team_goals, e.g. ["63c92926f920a9005c4e619c"].

exercise_sources.description: Exercise pools to draw from: "premium_stock", "free_stock", "team_exercises". The API defaults to free and premium stock.

locale.description: Language for names and text, as a locale code, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE" or "de". Omit for the default language.

save_to_library.description: true saves the workout to the team library as a private workout and returns its ID. Omit or false returns it without saving.

team_id.description: Not used: this tool works on the signed-in team. Leave it out.

user_requirements.description: Free-text guidance for the AI, up to 2000 characters, e.g. "Low impact, no jumping, knee friendly".

name: generate_workout
title: Generate workout
